subject: how do you change the size of the ggplot chart size in knitr markdown in pdf file

messages.author: f29d62ed7c6ee7e6
messages.subject: how do you change the size of the ggplot chart size in knitr markdown in pdf file
parts:
I am trying to use knitr and markdown to show some ggplot2 facet_wrap.

my df is something like this:

Hostname Date  Cpu
Server01   1/1/2015  4
Server01   1/2/205   5
Server01    1/3/2015  10
Server02   1/1/2015  6
Server02   1/2/205   20
Server02    1/3/2015  40

etc

If I have bunch of servers and I want to use this to show it in my pdf file:

```{r, results = 'asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,tidy=FALSE}

        print(ggplot(df,aes(Date, Cpu, group=Hostname, colour=Hostname))+geom_line()+
        geom_smooth(method="lm", se=T, colour="blue")+
        facet_wrap(~Hostname, ncol=3)+theme_bw()+
```

I see in the pdf output that ggplot output is fixed. It prints one output per page. Is it possible to adjust the plot size so that it enlarges if there are many servers so that I can see them. Right now, the plot size is fixed and if there are bunch of servers, each server chart shrinks.
